We also support the development of individuals and institutions in the countries where these diseases are prevalent. More information on TDR priorities can be found in the TDR Strategy 2024-2029 and TDR's Portfolio Prioritization Model. Selection criteria are explained in each grant call. Open calls for applications To view open and past calls, please go to eTDR portal. Vacancy Notices Call for applications: External consultant to support the Structured Operational Research and Training Initiative (SORT IT) Deadline for application: 15 October 2026 (17:00 CEST). Full details available here. Applications for this consultancy should be submitted through Dataform. You will be requested to attach your Stellis profile in PDF format to your application in Dataform. Stellis profiles can be created in the WHO Career Portal. Guidance on how to generate your general Stellis profile can be found in the Stellis user guide. In case of technical issues with the online submission in Dataform, please contact Ms Ekua Johnson at johnsone@who.int. No submissions will be accepted by email. TDR Postgraduate Scholarship in Implementation Research Eight universities provide Masters level degrees that focus on implementation research. Applications need to be submitted to the universities. The TDR Explorer database shows the different research communities created and their associations, the countries where research was undertaken and the publications that resulted from the research.
